nodes.title: BARE HANDS
nodes.description: Gather wood and stone at 25% tool speed.

nodes.title: AXE
nodes.description: Unlocks the axe and fast wood gathering.

nodes.title: SMART TOOLS
nodes.description: Automatically switches between the axe and pickaxe for the aimed resource.

nodes.title: HOLD TO HARVEST
nodes.description: Hold the attack mouse button to gather resources continuously.

nodes.title: POWER SWING
nodes.description: Every third resource hit also strikes nearby resources.

nodes.title: ICE WAND
nodes.description: Launch a freezing orb that freezes enemies near the impact.

nodes.title: RIFLE
nodes.description: Unlocks the rifle and ranged combat.

nodes.title: BOMBS
nodes.description: Unlocks throwable bombs for explosive crowd control.

nodes.title: FIELD REPAIRS
nodes.description: Restores 15% health to all surviving structures after each night.

nodes.title: NIGHT'S BOUNTY
nodes.description: Spawns one additional chest after every successfully survived night.

nodes.title: SAFE DELIVERY
nodes.description: Night's Bounty chests spawn closer to the base.

nodes.title: LIGHT FOOTWORK
nodes.description: Accelerate, stop, and change direction faster without increasing top speed.

nodes.title: DASH
nodes.description: Press Right Mouse Button to burst in the movement direction. One charge, recovered over time.
